title: 线张力与线迹质量
Thread Tension and Stitch Quality
goals: 能用夹线器公式 T出 = T入 + 2μN 和绞盘公式 T₂ = T₁e^{μθ} 计算面线线路上的张力变化。
Calculate tension changes along the needle-thread path with T_out = T_in + 2μN and the capstan equation T₂ = T₁e^{μθ}.
能用平衡带模型由两根线的张力比算出交织点位置，并求出夹线器的可调范围；能说明夹线器为什么要比底线紧好几倍。

Use the balance-band model to find the interlacing-point position from the tension ratio and the adjustment range of the tension assembly, and explain why the assembly must be several times tighter than the bobbin.
能按“先底线、后面线”的顺序判断线迹不平衡的原因。
Diagnose an unbalanced stitch following the rule “bobbin first, then needle thread”.
能区分四类缝皱，并用张力起皱模型估算缝线缩短和起皱量；能用收紧峰判据判断线会不会断。
Distinguish the four types of seam pucker, estimate seam shortening and pucker with the tension-pucker model, and judge thread breakage with the tightening-peak criterion.

title: 门襟皱成一条
A placket that puckers
text: 某衬衫厂缝门襟：棉布两层，布厚 1.0 mm，针距 3 mm，用 Tex 24 线（强力约 1000 cN，断裂伸长约 15%，示意值）。新来的修机工嫌线迹不够紧，把夹线器调到 220 cN、底线调到 90 cN。线迹两面看都很平衡，可缝好的门襟沿着缝线鼓起一条条细皱。已知交织点处的面线张力约为夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍，棉布的平衡带 B = 2.2，面料自身能吸收约 0.6% 的缩短（示意值）。

A shirt factory is sewing plackets: two plies of cotton, 1.0 mm thick, stitch length 3 mm, Tex 24 thread (strength about 1000 cN, elongation at break about 15%, illustrative). A new mechanic thinks the stitches are not tight enough and sets the tension assembly to 220 cN and the bobbin to 90 cN. The stitch looks balanced on both sides, but the finished placket puckers in fine ridges along the seam. The needle-thread tension at the interlacing point is about 0.41 times the tension-assembly setting, the balance band of cotton is B = 2.2, and the fabric itself can absorb about 0.6% shortening (illustrative).
question: 线迹真的平衡吗？缝 40 cm 门襟，缝线回缩会使缝长缩短多少，其中多少表现为起皱？怎样调才能既平衡又不皱？调回夹线器 100 cN、底线 40 cN 后结果如何？

Is the stitch really balanced? Over a 40 cm placket, how much does thread recovery shorten the seam, and how much of that shows as pucker? How should it be set to be both balanced and pucker-free? What happens with the assembly at 100 cN and the bobbin at 40 cN?
answer: 交织点处面线张力 0.41 × 220 ≈ 89 cN，与底线 90 cN 之比 r ≈ 0.99，交织点位置 z ≈ 0.50，确实平衡。但两根线平均张力约 90 cN，EA ≈ 1000/0.15 ≈ 6700 cN，用线比 (s + t)/s = 1.33，缝长缩短约 1.8%，扣掉面料能吸收的 0.6%，起皱约 1.2%，40 cm 门襟短约 4.8 mm，就是一条明显的皱。平衡只说明比例对，不说明大小对。保持比例、把两根线一起调松：夹线器 100 cN、底线 40 cN 时 r ≈ 1.02，z ≈ 0.51，仍平衡，交织点处面线约 41 cN、不松；平均张力约 40 cN，缩短约 0.81%，起皱约 0.21%，40 cm 只短约 0.8 mm，看不出皱。

The needle-thread tension at the interlacing point is 0.41 × 220 ≈ 89 cN; against the bobbin’s 90 cN, r ≈ 0.99 and z ≈ 0.50, so the stitch is indeed balanced. But the mean tension of the two threads is about 90 cN; with EA ≈ 1000/0.15 ≈ 6700 cN and thread usage (s + t)/s = 1.33, the seam shortens about 1.8%; less the 0.6% the fabric absorbs, the pucker is about 1.2%, or about 4.8 mm over 40 cm — a clearly visible pucker. Balance says the ratio is right, not the magnitude. Keep the ratio and loosen both threads together: with 100 cN and 40 cN, r ≈ 1.02 and z ≈ 0.51, still balanced, and the needle thread at the interlacing point is about 41 cN, not loose; the mean tension is about 40 cN, shortening about 0.81%, pucker about 0.21%, only about 0.8 mm over 40 cm — no visible pucker.

title: 绞盘摩擦 ↔ 腱绳驱动的机器人手
Capstan friction ↔ tendon-driven robot hands
text: 许多灵巧手和柔性机械臂用腱绳（钢丝绳或高强纤维绳）驱动：电机在手掌或前臂里拉绳，绳子绕过若干滑轮或在护套里弯过关节，再拉动指尖。这和面线从夹线器经过过线件、针眼到交织点是同一个问题，每一处包角都按 e^{μθ} 放大或削减张力。例如腱绳总包角 270°、μ = 0.1 时，电机端张力要比指尖端大约 1.6 倍，而且方向一反（放松时）比例就反过来，于是出现迟滞。所以机器人上不能只按电机电流估算指尖力，常在靠近关节处装张力传感器做闭环；这正对应第 7.8 节的电子张力：用电磁铁电流给定夹线力，并可按工序自动切换。

Many dexterous hands and soft arms are tendon-driven: a motor in the palm or forearm pulls a cable (steel or high-strength fibre), which wraps round pulleys or bends through a sheath across the joints to pull the fingertip. That is the same problem as the needle thread running from the tension assembly through the guides and eye to the interlacing point: every wrap multiplies or cuts the tension by e^{μθ}. With a total wrap of 270° and μ = 0.1, for example, the motor end must pull about 1.6 times the fingertip tension, and when the motion reverses (releasing) the ratio flips, producing hysteresis. So a robot cannot estimate fingertip force from motor current alone; a tension sensor near the joint is often used to close the loop — just like the electronic tension of Section 7.8, where a solenoid current sets the disc force and can switch automatically by operation.

title: 码头上的缆桩
A mooring bollard
text: 水手把缆绳在缆桩上绕两三圈，一个人就能拉住一条船：每多绕一圈，摩擦把张力放大好几倍，这就是绞盘公式。面线在针眼处拐约 180°，张力被削减到三分之一左右，是同一个道理反过来用。

A sailor wraps a mooring line two or three times round a bollard and one person can hold a ship: each extra turn multiplies the tension several times by friction — the capstan equation. The needle thread turning about 180° at the needle eye and losing two-thirds of its tension is the same principle working the other way.

title: 引子：四种看得见的毛病
Opening: four visible faults
points: 正面冒出底线小点：底线被拉上来。
Bobbin-thread dots on top: the bobbin thread is pulled up.
反面拖着面线圈：浮线。
Loops of needle thread underneath: looping.
缝线处鼓起细皱：缝皱。
Fine ridges along the seam: seam pucker.
面线断或起毛发白：断线。
The needle thread snaps or frays whitish: thread breakage.
前两种是比例不对，第三种多是两根都太紧，第四种是峰值超过线的承受力。
The first two are a wrong ratio, the third usually both too tight, the fourth a peak beyond what the thread can bear.
narration: 前几章讲的是一针怎么“形成”，今天讲形成得好不好。修机师傅看一段线迹，先看四样东西：正面有没有冒出底线的小点；反面有没有拖着一圈圈面线；缝过的地方平不平，有没有沿缝线鼓起细皱；线会不会断、有没有起毛发白。这四种毛病的根子都在线张力上，但病因各不相同。前两种是两根线张力的比例不对；第三种多半是两根线都太紧；第四种是张力的峰值超过了线能承受的程度。所以本讲要回答三个问题：张力从哪里来，比例怎样决定交织点的位置，大小怎样影响起皱和断线。

Earlier chapters explained how a stitch is formed; today is about whether it is formed well. Looking at a seam, a mechanic checks four things: are bobbin-thread dots showing on top; are loops of needle thread trailing underneath; is the seam flat, or are there fine ridges along it; and does the thread break or fray whitish? All four are rooted in thread tension, but the causes differ. The first two come from a wrong ratio between the two threads; the third usually from both being too tight; the fourth from the peak tension exceeding what the thread can bear. So this lesson answers three questions: where tension comes from, how the ratio decides where the interlacing point sits, and how the magnitude affects pucker and breakage.

title: 张力从哪里来
Where tension comes from
points: 面线：线团 → 夹线器 → 挑线簧 → 过线件 → 挑线杆线孔 → 针杆线钩 → 针眼。
Needle thread: cone → tension assembly → check spring → guides → take-up eye → bar guide → needle eye.
底线：梭芯 → 梭壳片簧，由调节螺钉定张力。
Bobbin thread: bobbin → bobbin-case leaf spring, set by an adjusting screw.
面线张力主要来自夹线器，沿途被过线件放大、在针眼处被削减。
Needle-thread tension comes mainly from the tension assembly, amplified by the guides and cut at the eye.
narration: 先看张力从哪里来，图 7-1 里蓝色是面线，橙色是底线。面线从线团出来，先经过夹线器，这是面线张力的主要来源；然后经过第 4 章讲的挑线簧，再绕过几个过线件、挑线杆的线孔和针杆线钩，最后穿过针眼。底线就简单多了：从梭芯抽出来，从梭壳上一片片簧下面穿过，片簧把它压在梭壳上，调节螺钉改变压力。面线路上每个零件都会改变张力：夹线器加一个定值，过线件按倍数放大，针眼处线拐了大约 180 度，张力被削掉一大截。下面两页把这两个公式讲清楚。

First, where does tension come from? In Fig. 7-1 blue is the needle thread and orange the bobbin thread. The needle thread leaves the cone and passes through the tension assembly — its main source of tension — then the check spring from Chapter 4, then wraps round several guides, the take-up lever eye and the needle-bar guide, and finally passes through the needle eye. The bobbin thread is much simpler: drawn off the bobbin, it passes under a leaf spring on the bobbin case, which presses it against the case; an adjusting screw changes that pressure. Every part on the needle-thread path changes the tension: the assembly adds a fixed amount, the guides multiply it, and at the eye, where the thread turns about 180°, a large part of it is cut away. The next two slides explain the two formulas.

title: 夹线器：加一个定值
The tension assembly: adding a fixed amount
points: 夹线柱、两片夹线盘、压簧、张力螺母；线从两盘之间穿过，两面受摩擦。
Tension stud, two discs, spring and nut; the thread passes between the discs and rubs on both faces.
压簧压力 N、摩擦系数 μ：出夹线器张力增加 2μN；拧紧螺母，N 增大。
Spring force N, friction μ: the tension rises by 2μN; tightening the nut increases N.
抬压脚时顶杆推开夹线盘，至少 0.5 mm（粗线可能 > 1.0 mm），线可无阻力抽出。
Lifting the foot pushes the discs apart by at least 0.5 mm (over 1.0 mm for thick thread), freeing the thread.
Example: in 10 cN, N = 200 cN, μ = 0.2 → out 90 cN.
narration: 夹线器由一根夹线柱、套在柱上的两片夹线盘、一根压簧和一个张力螺母组成。面线从两片盘中间穿过，压簧把两片盘压紧，线被拉动的时候两面都受摩擦，所以张力增加的是 2 乘 μ 乘 N。注意它是加一个定值，和进来的张力大小无关。拧紧螺母，压簧压得更紧，N 变大，面线张力就大，说明书规定的调节方向就是这个。举个数：进来 10 厘牛，压簧 200 厘牛，摩擦系数 0.2，出来就是 90 厘牛。还有个细节：抬起压脚时，顶杆把两片盘推开至少 0.5 毫米，线可以毫无阻力地抽出来，方便取布。

The tension assembly consists of a stud, two discs fitted on it, a compression spring and a nut. The needle thread passes between the two discs; the spring presses them together, and when the thread is pulled, friction acts on both of its faces, so the tension rises by 2 times μ times N. Note that this adds a fixed amount, regardless of the incoming tension. Tighten the nut, the spring compresses more, N rises and so does the needle-thread tension — exactly the direction the manual specifies. A number: 10 cN in, spring force 200 cN, μ 0.2, and 90 cN comes out. One more detail: when the presser foot is lifted, a pin pushes the discs at least 0.5 mm apart so the thread can be drawn out freely to remove the work.

title: 绞盘公式：乘一个倍数
The capstan equation: multiplying by a factor
points: 线在被拉动方向绕过包角 θ 的圆柱：T₂ = T₁e^{μθ}，按指数增长。
Thread pulled round a cylinder through wrap angle θ: T₂ = T₁e^{μθ}, growing exponentially.
反过来读：线总是从张力小的一端被拉向张力大的一端，上游张力小。
Read it backwards: thread is always pulled from the low-tension end to the high-tension end; upstream is lower.
收紧时交织点是上游；针眼拐约 180°，挑线杆处的张力传到交织点只剩约 1/3。
During tightening the interlacing point is upstream; turning about 180° at the eye, only about 1/3 of the take-up tension reaches it.
narration: 线绕过一个圆柱形零件，比如过线件，摩擦造成的张力增加就不是定值了，而是一个倍数：T₂ 等于 T₁ 乘 e 的 μθ 次方，这就是绞盘公式，也叫欧拉公式。看图 7-2，倍数随包角按指数增长：μ 0.2、绕 1 弧度，放大 1.22 倍；μ 0.35、绕 180 度，放大 3 倍。反过来读这个公式同样重要：线总是从张力小的一端被拉向张力大的一端。收紧线迹的时候，线从交织点经针眼向上滑向挑线杆，交织点这一端是上游，张力小。针眼处拐了约 180 度，挑线杆处的张力传到交织点，只剩三分之一左右。

When thread wraps round a cylindrical part such as a guide, the friction increase is no longer a fixed amount but a factor: T₂ equals T₁ times e to the μθ — the capstan equation, also called Euler’s formula. In Fig. 7-2 the factor grows exponentially with the wrap angle: μ 0.2 over 1 radian gives 1.22; μ 0.35 over 180° gives 3. Reading it the other way is just as important: thread is always pulled from its low-tension end towards its high-tension end. When a stitch is tightened, the thread slides from the interlacing point up through the eye towards the take-up lever, so the interlacing point is the upstream end with the lower tension. Turning about 180° at the eye, the take-up tension arrives at the interlacing point cut to roughly one third.

title: 底线与挑线簧
The bobbin thread and the check spring
points: 底线张力来自梭壳片簧；只在被拉出时才有张力，主要发生在收紧线迹时。
Bobbin tension comes from the case’s leaf spring and exists only while thread is drawn out, mainly during tightening.
底线张力在一针里基本不变，是稳定的基准。
It stays essentially constant within a stitch — a stable reference.
挑线簧：挑线杆放线时收住多余面线，保持小张力；行程约 7 mm，针尖到中等厚度布面时走完。
Check spring: takes up surplus needle thread while the lever pays out, keeping a small tension; stroke about 7 mm, finished as the needle point reaches a medium fabric.
narration: 再说底线。底线张力来自梭壳上的片簧，底线从片簧下面穿过，被压在梭壳上，调节螺钉改变压力。要注意一点：底线只有在被拉出来的时候才有张力，而它被拉出来，主要就发生在挑线杆收紧线迹的那一刻。正因为底线张力在一针里基本不变，它是一个稳定的基准，这一点后面讲调张力顺序时要用到。面线这边还有第 4 章讲过的挑线簧：挑线杆放线的时候，它把多余的面线收住，让面线保持一个小张力。维修手册要求它的行程约 7 毫米，在针尖到达中等厚度布面时走完。

Now the bobbin thread. Its tension comes from the leaf spring on the bobbin case: the thread passes under the spring, is pressed against the case, and an adjusting screw changes the pressure. Note one point: the bobbin thread has tension only while it is being drawn out, and that happens mainly at the moment the take-up lever tightens the stitch. Because the bobbin tension is essentially constant within a stitch, it makes a stable reference — we will use that when we discuss the order of adjustment. On the needle-thread side there is also the check spring from Chapter 4: while the take-up lever pays out, it takes up the surplus needle thread and keeps a small tension on it. The service manual asks for a stroke of about 7 mm, completed as the needle point reaches a medium-thickness fabric.

title: 一针中的面线张力
Needle-thread tension within one stitch
points: 研究发现：最高峰在收紧线迹那一刻，直接受夹线器预张力控制。
Research finds the highest peak at the moment of tightening, directly controlled by the tension-assembly pre-tension.
粗线收紧张力较低；布厚几乎不影响；夹线器附近转速影响很小；底线预张力只在脱环阶段起作用。
Thick threads tighten at lower tension; fabric thickness has almost no effect; speed matters little near the assembly; bobbin pre-tension acts only around cast-off.
55° 前从夹线器拉出下一针的线；55° 后放线，挑线簧维持小张力；206° 后绕梭形成第二个小峰。
Before 55° thread for the next stitch is drawn through the discs; after 55° it is paid out under the check spring; after 206° passing the case gives a second, smaller peak.
夹线器设定主要影响收紧峰：线迹多紧、交织点在哪、会不会断，都由它决定。
The assembly setting mainly affects the tightening peak, which decides how tight the stitch is, where the interlacing point sits and whether the thread breaks.
narration: 面线张力在一针里不是常数。有研究在夹线器下游装张力传感器，测出几条规律：最高的峰出现在收紧线迹的那一刻，它直接受夹线器预张力控制；粗线的收紧张力低一些；布的厚度几乎没影响；夹线器附近转速影响很小；底线预张力只在脱环阶段起作用。按这些规律画出图 7-3 的示意曲线。脱环以后挑线杆快速上升，形成收紧峰；到 55 度以前从夹线器拉出下一针的线；过了 55 度开始放线，挑线簧维持一个小张力；206 度钩线后线环绕梭，又出一个小峰。结论很实际：拧夹线器，改的主要就是这个收紧峰。

Needle-thread tension is not constant within a stitch. A study placed a tension sensor downstream of the tension assembly and found several regularities: the highest peak occurs at the moment the stitch is tightened, and it is directly controlled by the assembly’s pre-tension; thick threads tighten at lower tension; fabric thickness has almost no effect; near the assembly, speed matters little; and the bobbin pre-tension acts only around cast-off. Fig. 7-3 is an illustrative curve drawn from these. After cast-off the take-up lever rises fast, forming the tightening peak; up to 55° it draws the next stitch’s thread through the discs; after 55° it pays out and the check spring keeps a small tension; after the 206° catch the loop passes round the case and a second small peak appears. The practical conclusion: turning the tension nut mainly changes that tightening peak.

title: 线迹平衡：交织点被两头拉
Stitch balance: a tug of war at the interlacing point
points: 收紧时面线把交织点往上拉，底线把它往下拽；交织点向张力大的一边移动。
During tightening the needle thread pulls the interlacing point up and the bobbin thread down; it moves towards the larger tension.
面线大得多：交织点出布面，正面见底线；底线大得多：出布底，反面面线成圈。
Needle thread much larger: point pulled out on top, bobbin shows; bobbin much larger: pulled out underneath, needle-thread loops show.
布孔边缘的摩擦像刹车：张力比 r 在 1/B 到 B 之间，交织点停在布里（平衡带 B）。
Friction at the hole edges acts as a brake: with the ratio r between 1/B and B the point stays inside (balance band B).
narration: 收紧线迹的那一刻，挑线杆把面线往上拉，交织点跟着往上走；底线从梭壳里被拉出来，它的张力把交织点往下拽。这就像拔河：哪边张力大，交织点就往哪边走。面线一方大得多，交织点被拉出布面，正面就看得见底线；底线一方大得多，交织点被拉出布底，反面就是一圈圈面线。只有大致相等，交织点才停在布的中间，这叫线迹平衡。那为什么不需要严格相等呢？因为线在布孔上下边缘要拐弯，拐弯处有摩擦，像一个刹车。按绞盘公式，这个允许范围是一个倍数，教材叫平衡带 B。

At the moment the stitch is tightened, the take-up lever pulls the needle thread up and the interlacing point moves up with it; the bobbin thread is drawn out of the case, and its tension pulls the point down. It is a tug of war: the point moves towards whichever side pulls harder. If the needle thread is much stronger, the point is pulled out through the top and the bobbin thread shows on the face; if the bobbin thread is much stronger, it is pulled out underneath and the needle thread loops on the back. Only when they are roughly equal does the point stay in the middle of the fabric — stitch balance. Why need they not be exactly equal? Because the threads turn at the upper and lower edges of the hole, and friction there acts like a brake. By the capstan equation the tolerance is a factor, which the book calls the balance band B.

title: 平衡模型：张力比决定位置
The balance model: the ratio sets the position
points: 示意模型：z 从布底 0 到布面 1；z 在 0.4–0.6 为平衡区，对应 r ∈ [B^−0.2, B^0.2]。
Illustrative model: z from 0 at the bottom to 1 at the top; 0.4–0.6 is the balance zone, i.e. r ∈ [B^−0.2, B^0.2].
B 取决于布：厚、软、粗糙的布 B 大，好调；薄、滑的布 B 小，稍偏就跑到表面。
B depends on the fabric: thick, soft, rough fabric has a large B and is easy; thin, slippery fabric has a small B and drifts to a surface.
算例（示意）：衬里 1.8、棉布 2.2、牛仔布 3.0。
Example (illustrative): lining 1.8, cotton 2.2, denim 3.0.
线性关系只是教学简化：摩擦只说明带内都停得住，不给出停在哪里。
The linear relation is a teaching simplification: friction only says any position in the band holds, not where it settles.
narration: 教材用示意模型把它量化。交织点位置 z 从布底的 0 到布面的 1，r 是交织点处面线张力除以底线张力。公式里用 ln r 除以 ln B，再截在正负 1 之间：r 等于 1 时 z 是 0.5，正好在中间；r 等于 B 时交织点到布面。z 在 0.4 到 0.6 之间算平衡。看图 7-4 上排：棉布上 r 从 0.35 到 2.8，交织点从布底一路走到布面。下排是三种布的曲线：牛仔布 B 大，曲线平，好调；衬里 B 小，曲线陡，张力比稍有偏差交织点就跑到表面。这个线性关系只是教学简化。

The book quantifies this with an illustrative model. The interlacing-point position z runs from 0 at the bottom of the fabric to 1 at the top, and r is the needle-thread tension at the interlacing point divided by the bobbin tension. The formula takes ln r over ln B, clipped between minus one and one: at r = 1, z is 0.5, right in the middle; at r = B the point reaches the top. z between 0.4 and 0.6 counts as balanced. In the top row of Fig. 7-4, on cotton, as r goes from 0.35 to 2.8 the point travels from the bottom all the way to the top. The bottom shows the three fabrics: denim, with a large B, has a flat curve and is easy to set; lining, with a small B, is steep, and a slight error sends the point to the surface. Note that this linear relation is just a teaching simplification.

title: 夹线器为什么比底线紧好几倍
Why the tension assembly is several times tighter than the bobbin
points: Assembly → interlacing point: guides × e^{0.2×1} = 1.22, eye × e^{−0.35π} ≈ 1/3.
合起来交织点处面线张力 ≈ 0.41 × 夹线器设定值。
Together the needle-thread tension at the interlacing point ≈ 0.41 × the assembly setting.
底线 40 cN，要 r = 1，夹线器约 98 cN；棉布平衡区对应约 84–115 cN。
Bobbin 40 cN: r = 1 needs about 98 cN; the cotton balance zone corresponds to about 84–115 cN.
两个系数是算例值，机器、线不同差别很大，但“紧好几倍”通常如此。
The two factors are example values and vary widely, but “several times tighter” generally holds.
narration: 夹线器要比底线紧好几倍线迹才平衡，为什么？模型里用的是交织点处的面线张力。从夹线器到交织点，面线先绕过过线件被放大，算例取包角 1 弧度、μ 0.2，放大 1.22 倍；再穿过针眼被削减，包角 π、μ 0.35，只剩三分之一。两个一乘，交织点处面线张力大约是夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍。所以底线 40 厘牛，要让 r 等于 1，夹线器得调到约 98 厘牛；平衡区对应的夹线器范围大约是 84 到 115 厘牛。这两个系数是算例值，不同机器、不同线差别很大，但紧好几倍这个结论通常都成立。

Everyone on the shop floor knows the tension assembly must be several times tighter than the bobbin for the stitch to balance. Why? The model uses the needle-thread tension at the interlacing point. From the assembly to that point, the thread is first amplified by the guides — in the example a 1 radian wrap at μ 0.2, a factor of 1.22 — and then cut at the eye — a wrap of π at μ 0.35, leaving one third. Multiply them and the tension at the interlacing point is about 0.41 times the assembly setting. So with a 40 cN bobbin, r = 1 needs the assembly at about 98 cN, and the balance zone corresponds to roughly 84 to 115 cN. The two factors are example values and differ a lot between machines and threads, but the “several times tighter” conclusion generally holds.

title: 调张力的顺序与诊断
The order of adjustment and diagnosis
points: 先调底线，再按底线调面线：底线稳定是基准；调梭壳要取出，调夹线器只转螺母。
Bobbin first, then match the needle thread: the bobbin is the stable reference; adjusting the case means removing it, the assembly only needs a nut.
正面冒底线 = r 太大：面线太紧或底线太松；平时正常的机器突然这样，多半是底线出了问题。
Bobbin on top = r too large: needle too tight or bobbin too loose; on a normally good machine, suspect the bobbin side.
反面浮线 = r 太小：面线太松、底线太紧，或面线没卡进夹线盘（应抬压脚穿线）。
Loops underneath = r too small: needle too loose, bobbin too tight, or thread not seated between the discs (thread with the foot up).
平衡只说明比例对，不说明大小对：都松则线迹松垮，都紧则起皱、断线。
Balance says the ratio is right, not the magnitude: both loose gives slack stitches, both tight gives pucker and breaks.
narration: 调张力有个约定俗成的顺序：先调底线，再按底线调面线。理由两条：底线张力由片簧定，一针里基本不变，是稳定的基准；而且调梭壳要把它取出来，调夹线器只要转螺母，日常换料只动夹线器最方便。有了这个顺序，诊断也有了方向。正面冒底线，说明 r 太大，可能面线太紧，也可能底线太松；如果夹线器是平时的值，机器突然这样，更可能是底线出了问题，比如片簧松了、梭芯绕得太松。反面浮线说明 r 太小，还可能是面线没卡进夹线盘。最后强调：平衡只说明比例对，不说明大小对。

There is an established order for setting tension: set the bobbin first, then set the needle thread to match. Two reasons: the bobbin tension is fixed by the leaf spring and stays essentially constant within a stitch, making it a stable reference; and adjusting the case means taking it out, while the tension assembly only needs a turn of the nut, so routine changes touch only the assembly. This order also guides diagnosis. Bobbin showing on top means r is too large — needle too tight or bobbin too loose; if the assembly is at its usual setting and the machine suddenly does this, the bobbin side is the likelier culprit, such as a loose spring or a loosely wound bobbin. Loops underneath mean r is too small, or the thread is not seated between the discs. And remember: balance says the ratio is right, not the magnitude.

title: 四类缝皱
Four types of seam pucker
points: 张力起皱：线收紧时被拉长，缝后回缩把布拉短——在平衡前提下把张力降到最低。
Tension pucker: thread stretched during tightening recovers and shortens the fabric — lowest tension that still balances.
结构性起皱：密织布无空隙，针线把纱线挤开撑长——细针细线、减少针密、斜着缝。
Structural pucker: tight weaves have no room, needle and thread push yarns apart — finer needle and thread, fewer stitches, sew on the bias.
尺寸不稳定：洗烫后线和布收缩率不同——低缩率线、面料衬料缝线匹配。
Dimensional instability: thread and fabric shrink differently after washing — low-shrink thread, matched materials.
送布起皱：两层送得不一样多（第 6 章）——调压脚、牙高或换送布方式。
Feed pucker: plies fed unequally (Chapter 6) — adjust foot and dog height or change the feed system.
narration: 线业企业的资料把缝皱分成四类，看图 7-5。第一类张力起皱：缝线收紧时被拉长，缝好后张力消失，线要弹回去，就把缝线那一条布拉短，布只好拱起来。对策是保持平衡的前提下把张力降到最低。第二类结构性起皱：织得很密的布，纱线之间没有空隙，机针刺进去把纱线挤开，布被撑长，两边鼓起，要用细针细线、少几针。第三类尺寸不稳定：洗涤熨烫后线和布缩得不一样多。第四类送布起皱，就是第 6 章的上下层错位。四类里和本章直接相关的是张力起皱，下一页把它算出来。

Material from a thread maker groups seam pucker into four types — see Fig. 7-5. First, tension pucker: the thread is stretched while the stitch is tightened; once sewn, the tension goes, the thread springs back and shortens the strip of fabric along the seam, which can only buckle. The remedy is the lowest tension that still balances. Second, structural pucker: in a very tight weave there is no space between yarns, so the needle pushes them apart and stretches the fabric, and both sides bulge; use finer needle and thread and fewer stitches. Third, dimensional instability: after washing and pressing, thread and fabric shrink by different amounts. Fourth, feed pucker — the ply shift of Chapter 6. Of the four, tension pucker belongs to this chapter, and the next slide calculates it.

title: 张力起皱的估算
Estimating tension pucker
points: 线的伸长 ε = T/EA，EA ≈ 强力 ÷ 断裂伸长；每厘米缝长用线约 (s + t)/s。
Thread strain ε = T/EA, EA ≈ strength ÷ elongation at break; thread per unit seam about (s + t)/s.
缝长缩短率 ≈ 两者之积；面料能吸收一小部分（衬里约 0.3%、棉布约 0.6%，示意），超出的就是起皱。
Seam shortening ≈ their product; the fabric absorbs a little (lining about 0.3%, cotton about 0.6%, illustrative); the rest is pucker.
棉布两层、3 mm、Tex 24：平均 40 cN → 缩短 0.81%，起皱 0.21%，40 cm 短约 0.8 mm。
Two plies of cotton, 3 mm, Tex 24: mean 40 cN → shortening 0.81%, pucker 0.21%, about 0.8 mm over 40 cm.
两根线都调到约 2.2 倍（220/90 cN）：仍平衡，但缩短约 1.8%、起皱约 1.2%，40 cm 短近 5 mm。
Both raised about 2.2 times (220/90 cN): still balanced, but about 1.8% shortening and 1.2% pucker, nearly 5 mm over 40 cm.
narration: 张力起皱可以用示意模型估算。线收紧时的伸长率约等于张力除以拉伸刚度 EA，EA 约为强力除以断裂伸长率；每厘米缝长上用的线大约是 (s+t)/s；两者相乘，就是两根线回缩造成的缝长缩短率。面料自己能吸收一小部分，超出的就是起皱。算例：棉布两层、针距 3 毫米、Tex 24 线，平均张力 40 厘牛，缩短约 0.81%，起皱约 0.21%，40 厘米短 0.8 毫米。两根线都调紧到 2.2 倍，仍然平衡，起皱却到 1.2%，短近 5 毫米。图 7-6 还说明粗线起皱轻，但薄料上粗线又会结构性起皱。

Tension pucker can be estimated with an illustrative model. The thread’s strain during tightening is about the tension divided by its tensile stiffness EA, with EA roughly strength over elongation at break; the thread used per unit seam is about (s + t)/s; their product is the fractional shortening caused by the two threads recovering. The fabric absorbs a little, and the rest is pucker. Example: two plies of cotton, 3 mm stitch, Tex 24, mean tension at the interlacing point 40 cN — shortening about 0.81%, pucker about 0.21%, 0.8 mm over 40 cm, invisible. Tighten both threads 2.2 times and the stitch is still balanced, but pucker reaches 1.2%, nearly 5 mm short. Fig. 7-6 also shows that thicker thread stretches less and puckers less, but on light fabric it causes structural pucker instead.

title: 断线：收紧峰与线的承受力
Thread breakage: the tightening peak and thread capacity
points: 面线多半断在收紧峰上；高速穿针眼、与旋梭摩擦、针热软化，使实际承受力远低于名义强力。
Needle thread usually breaks at the tightening peak; high-speed passes through the eye, hook friction and needle heat cut real capacity well below nominal strength.
示意约定：挑线杆处收紧峰 ≈ 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²)；不超过名义强力的 1/3 算安全。
Illustrative convention: tightening peak at the take-up ≈ 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²); safe if not above 1/3 of nominal strength.
牛仔四层：交织点两线约 100 cN → 夹线器约 246 cN → 5000 r/min 峰值约 345 cN。
Four plies of denim: about 100 cN at the interlacing point → assembly about 246 cN → peak about 345 cN at 5000 r/min.
占 Tex 24（1000 cN）的 35%，超标；占 Tex 40（1700 cN）的 20%：厚料配粗线（DB×1 #20–#23 粗针）。
That is 35% of Tex 24 (1000 cN), too much; 20% of Tex 40 (1700 cN): heavy material needs thick thread (DB×1 #20–#23 needles).
narration: 再看断线。面线多半断在收紧峰上，峰高由夹线器预张力决定。线能承受的也不是拉力机测出的强力：高速下线反复穿过针眼、和旋梭摩擦，机针在布里摩擦发热，合成纤维线遇热还会软化，承受力要打不少折扣。教材用两条示意约定：挑线杆处的收紧峰约为 1.22 倍夹线器设定值，再随转速升高约 15%；峰值不超过名义强力的三分之一算安全。算例牛仔四层，交织点要 100 厘牛，夹线器约 246 厘牛，5000 转时峰值约 345 厘牛，占 Tex 24 线的 35%，超标；换 Tex 40 只占 20%。厚料要配粗线。

Now breakage. The needle thread usually breaks at the tightening peak, whose height is set by the assembly’s pre-tension. And what a thread can withstand is not its tensile-tester strength: at high speed it passes repeatedly through the eye, rubs on the hook, the needle heats up in the fabric and synthetic threads soften, so the real capacity is much lower. The book uses two illustrative conventions: the peak at the take-up lever is about 1.22 times the assembly setting, rising about 15% more with speed; and a peak not above one third of nominal strength is safe. In the denim example, 100 cN is needed at the interlacing point, so the assembly is about 246 cN and the peak at 5000 r/min about 345 cN — 35% of Tex 24, too much; Tex 40 is only 20%. Heavy fabric needs thick thread.

title: 缺陷速查与电子张力
Defect quick guide and electronic tension
points: 正面冒底线：先查底线是否太松（梭壳弹簧、梭芯绕线），再看面线是否过紧（7.4、7.5）。
Bobbin on top: first check for a loose bobbin (case spring, winding), then a tight needle thread (7.4, 7.5).
反面浮线：面线是否卡进夹线盘、夹线器是否太松，挑线簧与挑线杆（第 4 章）。
Loops underneath: is the thread seated in the discs, is the assembly too loose, check spring and take-up (Chapter 4).
缝皱、断线、跳针、针距不匀分别查张力与针线、毛刺、钩线三量（第 5 章）、送布（第 6 章）。
Pucker, breakage, skips and uneven stitches: tension and needle/thread, burrs, the three hook settings (Chapter 5), the feed (Chapter 6).
电子张力：电磁铁推动夹线盘，电流给定张力，可存储、按工序甚至一条缝的不同段自动切换（第 14 章）。
Electronic tension: a solenoid pushes the discs, current sets the tension, stored and switched by operation or even within a seam (Chapter 14).
narration: 线迹的毛病往往不止一个原因，教材 7.7 节有一张速查表，把前几章串了起来，大家可以当作现场判断的起点。正面冒底线，先查底线是不是太松；反面浮线，先查面线有没有卡进夹线盘；缝皱查张力、针线粗细和上下层错位；断线查张力、针眼和过线件有没有毛刺；跳针回到第 5 章查钩线三个量；针距不匀回到第 6 章查送布。最后说电子张力。机械夹线器的张力由螺母位置定，换料就得手工重调，缝的时候也不能变。电子张力把压簧换成电磁铁，张力由电流给定，可以存储、按工序自动切换，控制方法第 14 章再讲。

Stitch faults often have more than one cause, and Section 7.7 has a quick-guide table tying the earlier chapters together as a starting point on the shop floor. Bobbin on top: first check whether the bobbin is too loose. Loops underneath: first check that the needle thread is seated between the discs. Pucker: tension, needle and thread size, ply shift. Breakage: tension, and burrs on the eye and guides. Skips: back to Chapter 5 and the three hook settings. Uneven stitch length: back to Chapter 6 and the feed. Finally, electronic tension. A mechanical assembly’s tension is set by the nut’s position, so every material change needs manual readjustment and it cannot change during sewing. Electronic tension replaces the spring with a solenoid; the current sets the tension, which can be stored and switched by operation. Control methods come in Chapter 14.

title: 模型的边界与现场要点
Limits of the model and shop-floor notes
points: 0.41、平衡带 B、起皱和断线判据都是示意值；起皱模型把穿过布厚的那段线也算作缩短，偏大。
0.41, the balance band B, the pucker and breakage criteria are illustrative; the pucker model counts the thread through the fabric thickness as shortening, an overestimate.
真实张力是动态的，还与挑线杆速度、挑线簧、线的弹性有关；具体数值靠试缝调定。
Real tension is dynamic and depends on take-up speed, check spring and thread elasticity; actual values are set by test sewing.
模型讲清两个关系：比例决定位置，大小决定松紧和起皱。
The model makes two relations clear: the ratio sets the position; the magnitude sets tightness and pucker.
先调底线再调面线；冒底线先查梭壳梭芯；浮线先查穿线；起皱两线一起调松；断线先查毛刺。
Bobbin first, then needle thread; bobbin on top, check case and bobbin; loops, check threading; pucker, loosen both; breakage, check for burrs.
narration: 最后是模型的边界。本讲的平衡和起皱模型都是示意性的：0.41 这个比值取决于包角、针眼形状、线的表面和润滑，不同机器差别很大；平衡带 B 只是把布孔边缘的摩擦概括成一个数；起皱模型只算了缝线的弹性回缩，还把穿过布厚那段线的回缩也全算成缝长缩短，是偏大的估计；断线判据更粗略。真实张力是动态的。模型的用处是讲清楚两个关系：比例决定位置，大小决定松紧和起皱。具体的张力值，现场仍要试缝。几条现场要点：先调底线再调面线；冒底线先查梭壳和梭芯；浮线先查穿线；起皱时两根线一起调松；断线先查毛刺。

Finally, the limits of the model. The balance and pucker models in this lesson are illustrative: the 0.41 ratio depends on wrap angles, eye shape, thread surface and lubrication and varies widely; the balance band B lumps the friction at the hole edges into one number; the pucker model counts only elastic recovery and treats the thread passing through the fabric thickness as seam shortening too, which overestimates it; the breakage criterion is cruder still. Real tension is dynamic. What the model gives us is two clear relations: the ratio sets the position, and the magnitude sets tightness and pucker. Actual tension values are still found by test sewing. Shop-floor notes: bobbin first, then needle thread; bobbin on top, check case and bobbin; loops, check the threading; pucker, loosen both threads together; breakage, look for burrs first.

summary: 夹线器给面线加一个定值 2μN；过线件按 e^{μθ} 放大，针眼处拐约 180° 削减到约 1/3，交织点处面线张力约为夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍。
The tension assembly adds a fixed 2μN; guides multiply by e^{μθ}, and the 180° turn at the eye cuts to about 1/3, so the interlacing-point tension is about 0.41 of the setting.
面线张力的最高峰在收紧线迹那一刻，由夹线器预张力决定；它决定线迹松紧、交织点位置和会不会断线。
The highest needle-thread peak occurs at tightening and is set by the assembly pre-tension; it decides tightness, interlacing-point position and breakage.
交织点位置由两根线的张力比决定，布孔摩擦给出平衡带 B；先调底线、再按底线调面线，诊断时先判断是哪一边变了。
The interlacing-point position is set by the tension ratio, with a balance band B from hole-edge friction; set the bobbin first and diagnose which side changed.
平衡只说明比例对：张力大小决定松紧、张力起皱（缩短 ≈ T/EA × (s + t)/s）和断线（收紧峰 ≤ 名义强力的 1/3）。
Balance means only the ratio is right: the magnitude sets tightness, tension pucker (shortening ≈ T/EA × (s + t)/s) and breakage (peak ≤ 1/3 of nominal strength).
缝皱有张力、结构、尺寸不稳定、送布四类；电子张力用电流给定夹线力，可按工序自动切换。
Pucker comes in four types — tension, structural, dimensional instability and feed; electronic tension sets the disc force by current and switches automatically by operation.

title: 张力平衡与线迹截面
Tension balance and stitch cross-section
goal: 观察夹线器张力与底线张力怎样决定交织点位置和线迹外观。
See how the tension-assembly and bobbin tensions decide the interlacing-point position and the look of the stitch.
学会按“先判断哪一边变了”的思路修好不平衡的线迹。
Learn to fix an unbalanced stitch by first working out which side changed.
体会面料、缝线、转速对起皱和断线的影响，找到“平衡、不松、不皱、不断”的可用区。
See how fabric, thread and speed affect pucker and breakage, and find the region that is balanced, not loose, pucker-free and unbroken.
theory: 交织点处面线张力 T_n ≈ 0.41 T_d；张力比 r = T_n/T_b；z = 0.5 + 0.5·clip(ln r/ln B, −1, 1)，平衡区 0.4–0.6（衬里 B = 1.8、棉布 2.2、牛仔 3.0）。
T_n ≈ 0.41 T_d at the interlacing point; r = T_n/T_b; z = 0.5 + 0.5·clip(ln r/ln B, −1, 1), balance zone 0.4–0.6 (lining B = 1.8, cotton 2.2, denim 3.0).
线迹太松：两根线中较小的张力低于面料所需（示意：衬里 20、棉布 35、牛仔 100 cN）。
Too loose: the smaller of the two tensions is below what the fabric needs (illustrative: lining 20, cotton 35, denim 100 cN).
起皱 = (T_n + T_b)/2 ÷ EA × (s + t)/s − 面料可吸收量；断线：收紧峰 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²) 超过名义强力 1/3。
Pucker = (T_n + T_b)/2 ÷ EA × (s + t)/s − fabric absorption; breakage: peak 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²) above 1/3 of nominal strength.
线对密织薄料太粗会结构性起皱（衬里不宜超过 Tex 24）。
Thread too thick for a tight light fabric causes structural pucker (no thicker than Tex 24 on lining).
steps: 打开实验页，保持默认（衬衫棉布两层、Tex 24、夹线器 100 cN、底线 40 cN、针距 3 mm、5000 r/min），记录读数区六个读数，观察截面和正反面。
Open the lab with defaults (two plies of shirt cotton, Tex 24, assembly 100 cN, bobbin 40 cN, 3 mm, 5000 r/min); record the six readings and look at the cross-section and both faces.
只拖动“夹线器张力”滑杆，从 60 cN 到 160 cN，找出交织点位置离开 0.4–0.6 的两个夹线器值，与教材 84–115 cN 比较。
Drag only the tension-assembly slider from 60 to 160 cN; find the two settings where z leaves 0.4–0.6 and compare with the book’s 84–115 cN.
按“打乱张力”，先看交织点偏向哪一面、是否起皱，再调两根线（或点击张力平面图的绿色区），使线迹良好（任务 1）。
Press “Scramble tension”; note which way the point has moved and whether it puckers, then adjust both threads (or click the green region of the tension plane) until the stitch is good (Task 1).

Press “Machine with a loose bobbin”; drag only the bobbin slider, leaving assembly, thread and fabric alone, until the stitch is good (Task 2).
面料选“牛仔布四层”、转速 5000 r/min 以上：先用 Tex 24 找可用区，观察断线风险；再换 Tex 40，使线迹平衡、不松、不断（任务 3）。
Choose four plies of denim at 5000 r/min or more: look for a usable region with Tex 24 and note the breakage risk; then switch to Tex 40 and get a balanced, firm, unbroken stitch (Task 3).
面料选“衬里两层”：保持平衡，把两根线的张力一起降到刚好不松，使起皱 ≤ 0.15%（任务 4）；试一下 Tex 40 会出现什么。
Choose two plies of lining: keep balance and lower both tensions together to just above loose until pucker ≤ 0.15% (Task 4); try Tex 40 and see what happens.
在棉布上分别改变针距（1.5–5 mm）和转速（2000–6000 r/min），记录起皱和收紧峰的变化。
On cotton, vary the stitch length (1.5–5 mm) and speed (2000–6000 r/min) and record how pucker and the tightening peak change.

In Task 2, why does loosening the tension assembly also bring the point back to the middle, yet is not the right fix?

On lining, why can tension pucker not be reduced by switching to thicker thread?

title: 线张力计算与线迹诊断
Thread-tension calculations and stitch diagnosis
tasks: （计算）面线进入夹线器时 10 cN，压簧压力 200 cN，μ = 0.2，出夹线器后张力是多少？再依次绕过三个包角各 90°、μ = 0.25 的过线件，张力是多少？若把其中一个包角减为 45°，结果如何？

(Calculation) The needle thread enters the assembly at 10 cN, spring force 200 cN, μ = 0.2. What is the tension on leaving? It then passes round three guides of 90° each, μ = 0.25: what is the tension? What if one wrap is reduced to 45°?
（计算）棉布两层（B = 2.2），底线 40 cN，交织点处面线张力为夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍。求使交织点位于 0.4–0.6 的夹线器范围；若还要求交织点处张力不低于 35 cN，范围变为多少？在虚拟实验 7-1 中验证并截图。

(Calculation) Two plies of cotton (B = 2.2), bobbin 40 cN, interlacing-point needle tension 0.41 times the setting. Find the assembly range that keeps the point within 0.4–0.6; if the tension at the point must also be at least 35 cN, what is the range? Verify in Virtual lab 7-1 with a screenshot.
（计算）牛仔布四层，交织点处两根线张力都要达到 100 cN。求夹线器最小设定值和 5000 r/min 时的收紧峰；按峰值不超过名义强力三分之一的判据，Tex 24（1000 cN）和 Tex 40（1700 cN）哪种可用？

(Calculation) Four plies of denim need 100 cN in both threads at the interlacing point. Find the minimum assembly setting and the tightening peak at 5000 r/min; by the one-third criterion, which can be used, Tex 24 (1000 cN) or Tex 40 (1700 cN)?
（诊断）一台平缝机昨天正常，今天正面每针冒出底线小点，操作工把夹线器越拧越松，结果反面又开始浮线。用 7.4、7.5 节的道理分析原因，写出正确的处理步骤。

(Diagnosis) A machine was fine yesterday; today bobbin dots show on top at every stitch, and the operator keeps loosening the assembly until loops appear underneath. Using Sections 7.4 and 7.5, analyse the cause and write the correct procedure.

text: 面线进入夹线器时张力 5 cN，压簧压力 N = 150 cN，线与夹线盘的摩擦系数 μ = 0.25。出夹线器后张力是多少 cN？
The needle thread enters the tension assembly at 5 cN; spring force N = 150 cN; friction between thread and discs μ = 0.25. What is the tension on leaving, in cN?
feedback: 线两面受摩擦：5 + 2 × 0.25 × 150 = 80 cN。只算一面会得到 42.5 cN。
Friction acts on both faces: 5 + 2 × 0.25 × 150 = 80 cN. Counting one face gives 42.5 cN.

text: 面线绕过一个包角 120°、μ = 0.2 的过线件，张力放大多少倍？
The needle thread wraps round a guide through 120° with μ = 0.2. By what factor is the tension multiplied?
feedback: θ = 120° = 2.094 rad，e^{0.2 × 2.094} ≈ 1.52。把角度直接用 120 代入会得到荒谬的结果，要换成弧度。
θ = 120° = 2.094 rad; e^{0.2 × 2.094} ≈ 1.52. The angle must be in radians, not 120.

text: 收紧线迹时，面线从交织点经针眼滑向挑线杆，所以交织点处的面线张力比挑线杆处小。
During tightening the needle thread slides from the interlacing point through the eye towards the take-up lever, so the tension at the interlacing point is lower than at the lever.
feedback: 线总是从张力小的一端被拉向张力大的一端，交织点是上游；针眼处拐约 180°，按绞盘公式削减到约 1/3。
Thread is pulled from low tension to high; the interlacing point is upstream, and the 180° turn at the eye cuts the tension to about 1/3 by the capstan equation.

text: 线迹正面每个针孔处都冒出底线的小点，说明：
Bobbin-thread dots appear at every needle hole on the top side. This means:
张力比 r（面线 ÷ 底线）太大：面线太紧或底线太松
The ratio r (needle ÷ bobbin) is too large: needle thread too tight or bobbin too loose
r 太小：面线太松或底线太紧
r is too small: needle thread too loose or bobbin too tight
两根线的张力都太大，线迹起皱
Both tensions are too high and the seam puckers
钩线时刻太早，梭尖没钩住线环
Loop-catch timing is too early and the hook missed the loop

feedback: 面线一方相对太大，交织点被拉出布面，正面就看到底线。既可能是面线紧，也可能是底线松，所以要先判断哪一边变了。
The needle side is relatively too strong, so the interlacing point is pulled out on top. It could be a tight needle thread or a loose bobbin, so first find out which side changed.

text: 底线张力 30 cN，交织点处面线张力约为夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍。要使张力比 r = 1，夹线器应调到约多少 cN？
Bobbin tension 30 cN; the needle-thread tension at the interlacing point is about 0.41 times the assembly setting. For r = 1, roughly what should the assembly be set to, in cN?
feedback: T_d = 30/0.41 ≈ 73 cN，是底线的约 2.4 倍。直接调成 30 cN 时交织点处面线只有约 12 cN，反面会浮线。
T_d = 30/0.41 ≈ 73 cN, about 2.4 times the bobbin. Setting it to 30 cN gives only about 12 cN at the interlacing point, and loops appear underneath.

text: 调张力约定俗成的顺序是先调底线、再按底线调面线，主要理由是：
The established order is to set the bobbin first and then match the needle thread. The main reason is:
底线张力由片簧定，一针中基本不变，是稳定的基准；调夹线器只需转螺母，日常最方便
Bobbin tension is set by the leaf spring and is nearly constant within a stitch, a stable reference; the assembly needs only a nut turn
底线张力总是比面线大，所以要先定大的
The bobbin tension is always larger, so set the larger first
面线张力不影响交织点位置
The needle tension does not affect the interlacing-point position
夹线器在缝制中会自动跟随底线变化
The assembly automatically follows the bobbin during sewing

feedback: 面线张力受挑线、过线件、转速影响多，适合“跟着调”；底线稳定，而且调梭壳要取出梭壳，所以先定底线。
Needle tension is affected by take-up, guides and speed, so it is the one adjusted to match; the bobbin is stable and adjusting it means removing the case, so it goes first.

text: 下列哪些措施能减轻张力起皱？
Which measures reduce tension pucker?
保持线迹平衡的前提下，把两根线的张力一起降低
Lower both tensions together while keeping the stitch balanced
绕梭芯时不要绕得太紧
Do not wind the bobbin too tightly
选用伸长控制得好的线
Choose a thread with well-controlled elongation
只把夹线器拧紧，让线迹更结实
Tighten only the assembly so the stitch is firmer
在密织薄料上换更粗的针和线
Use a thicker needle and thread on a tightly woven light fabric

feedback: 张力起皱来自线的弹性回缩，要降低张力、减小伸长。只拧紧夹线器既增大张力又破坏平衡；密织薄料上粗针粗线会造成结构性起皱。

Tension pucker comes from elastic recovery, so lower tension and stretch. Tightening only the assembly raises tension and unbalances the stitch; thick needle and thread on a tight light fabric causes structural pucker.

text: 只要交织点位于布的厚度中间（线迹平衡），两根线的张力大小就一定合适。
As long as the interlacing point lies in the middle of the fabric (balanced stitch), the magnitude of both tensions must be right.
feedback: 平衡只说明比例对。两根线都太松，线迹松垮；都太紧，同样平衡，却会起皱、断线。
Balance only means the ratio is right. Both too loose gives slack stitches; both too tight is still balanced but puckers and breaks.

text: 面线断线最常发生在一针中的哪个时刻？
At what point in a stitch does the needle thread most often break?
挑线杆收紧线迹的收紧峰
At the tightening peak, when the take-up lever sets the stitch
挑线杆放线、挑线簧维持小张力的阶段
While the take-up pays out and the check spring holds a small tension
针尖刺入布料的那一刻
At the instant the needle point enters the fabric
送布牙升出针板的那一刻
When the feed dog emerges above the plate

feedback: 收紧峰是一针中面线张力的最高峰，由夹线器预张力决定，所以断线多半断在这里。
The tightening peak is the highest needle-thread tension in the stitch, set by the assembly pre-tension, so breaks mostly happen there.

text: 衬里两层平衡带 B = 1.8，底线 30 cN，交织点处面线张力为夹线器设定值的 0.41 倍。交织点位置 z 不超过 0.6（即 r ≤ B^0.2）时，夹线器最大可调到多少 cN？
Two plies of lining, B = 1.8, bobbin 30 cN, interlacing-point needle tension 0.41 times the setting. For z no more than 0.6 (r ≤ B^0.2), what is the maximum assembly setting in cN?
feedback: B^0.2 = 1.8^0.2 = 1.125; T_d ≤ 1.125 × 30/0.41 ≈ 82 cN. Lining has a small B, so the range is narrow, only about 12% above the 73 cN for r = 1.

text: 棉布两层（布厚 1.0 mm）、针距 3 mm，用 Tex 40 线（强力 1700 cN、断裂伸长 16%，EA ≈ 强力 ÷ 断裂伸长）。交织点处两根线平均张力 60 cN，面料可吸收 0.6% 的缩短。按 7.6 节模型，缝 40 cm 起皱造成的缩短是多少 mm？

Two plies of cotton (1.0 mm), 3 mm stitch, Tex 40 thread (strength 1700 cN, elongation 16%, EA ≈ strength ÷ elongation). Mean tension at the interlacing point 60 cN; the fabric absorbs 0.6%. Using the model of Section 7.6, how many mm of pucker does a 40 cm seam show?
feedback: EA = 1700/0.16 = 10 625 cN; shortening = 60/10 625 × 4/3 = 0.753%; pucker 0.753% − 0.6% = 0.153%; × 400 mm ≈ 0.61 mm. Forgetting the absorption gives about 3.0 mm.

text: 按 7.7 节的约定，收紧峰 ≈ 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²)。夹线器设定 200 cN、主轴 4000 r/min 时，挑线杆处收紧峰约为多少 cN？
By the convention of Section 7.7, the tightening peak ≈ 1.22 T_d (1 + 0.15 (n/5000)²). With the assembly at 200 cN and the shaft at 4000 r/min, what is the peak at the take-up lever in cN?
一台平缝机昨天正常，今天正面每针冒底线；操作工把夹线器越拧越松，反面又开始浮线。最合理的判断是：
A machine was fine yesterday; today bobbin shows on top at every stitch; the operator loosens the assembly more and more until loops appear underneath. The most sensible judgement is:
问题多半在底线一侧（片簧松、梭芯绕松或装反），应先恢复夹线器、检查梭壳和梭芯
The problem is probably on the bobbin side (loose spring, loosely wound or reversed bobbin); restore the assembly and inspect case and bobbin
夹线器坏了，应更换夹线器
The assembly is faulty and should be replaced
面线太粗，应换细线
The needle thread is too thick and should be changed for a finer one
钩线时刻跑了，应重调旋梭
The hook timing has drifted and the hook should be reset

feedback: 夹线器是按平时的值调的，突然冒底线更可能是底线变松。拧松夹线器只是把面线张力也降低，两根线都偏松，结果浮线。
The assembly was at its usual setting, so a sudden bobbin-on-top fault more likely means a loose bobbin. Loosening the assembly just makes both threads slack, so loops appear.

text: 关于平衡带 B，下列说法哪些正确？
Which statements about the balance band B are correct?
张力比 r 在 1/B 到 B 之间时，交织点停在布的厚度里
With r between 1/B and B the interlacing point stays within the fabric thickness
厚而软、表面粗糙的布孔边摩擦大，B 大，平衡容易调
Thick, soft, rough fabrics have more hole-edge friction, a larger B and easier balance
薄而滑的衬里 B 小，张力比稍有偏差交织点就跑到表面
Thin slippery lining has a small B, so a slight ratio error sends the point to a surface
B 就是夹线器张力与底线张力之比
B is simply the ratio of assembly tension to bobbin tension

feedback: B 概括的是布孔上下边缘的摩擦“刹车”，与面料有关；张力比是 r，不是 B。
B sums up the friction “brake” at the hole edges and depends on the fabric; the tension ratio is r, not B.

text: 电子张力把压簧换成由电磁铁推动的夹线盘，面线张力由电流给定，可以按工序甚至在一条缝线的不同段自动切换。
Electronic tension replaces the spring with discs pushed by a solenoid; the needle tension is set by current and can switch automatically by operation or even within one seam.
feedback: 这是电子张力相对机械夹线器的主要优势：可设定、可存储、可在缝制中改变；控制方法见第 14 章。
This is its main advantage over a mechanical assembly: it can be set, stored and changed during sewing; control methods are in Chapter 14.

key: 夹线器与绞盘公式；张力比决定交织点位置；先底线后面线的调整与诊断。
Tension assembly and capstan equation; the ratio sets the interlacing point; bobbin-first adjustment and diagnosis.
difficult: 为什么交织点处面线张力只有夹线器设定值的约 0.41 倍（上游张力小）；平衡与张力大小是两回事；起皱模型的建立。
Why the interlacing-point tension is only about 0.41 of the setting (upstream is lower); balance versus magnitude; building the pucker model.

phase: 导入：四种毛病与门襟起皱
Opening: four faults and a puckered placket
content: 展示冒底线、浮线、缝皱、断线的样品，提出门襟起皱问题。
Show samples of bobbin on top, loops, pucker and breakage; pose the placket problem.
夹线器与绞盘公式，当堂算 2μN 与 e^{μθ}；梭壳弹簧、挑线簧；一针中的面线张力曲线。
Tension assembly and capstan equation with in-class calculation; bobbin spring and check spring; the tension curve within a stitch.
交织点拔河、平衡带模型、0.41 的来历；当堂算棉布夹线器范围；调张力顺序与诊断。
The tug of war, the balance-band model, where 0.41 comes from; compute the cotton range in class; adjustment order and diagnosis.
四类缝皱、张力起皱模型、收紧峰判据与牛仔算例；缺陷速查表与电子张力。
Four pucker types, the tension-pucker model, the peak criterion and denim example; quick guide and electronic tension.
分组完成四个任务与记录表，重点完成“只调底线”任务并讨论为什么不能拧夹线器。
Groups complete the four tasks and log, focusing on the bobbin-only task and why the assembly should not be touched.
用模型解答门襟起皱问题；归纳“比例定位置、大小定松紧和起皱”；布置作业。
Solve the placket problem with the model; sum up “ratio sets position, magnitude sets tightness and pucker”; set the assignment.

homework: 完成作业“线张力计算与线迹诊断”；预习第 8 章，思考把旋梭调晚几度为什么会引起断线。
Complete the assignment “Thread-tension calculations and stitch diagnosis”; preview Chapter 8 and think about why retarding the hook a few degrees can cause thread breaks.
